item.title: War-hammered Gaza needs basics like homes, roads and power. FIFA is offering a $50M soccer stadium
item.description: FIFA says it'll pay to build a new $50 million national soccer stadium in war-ravaged Gaza, where two years of fighting between Hamas and Israel have left housing, electricity and basic infrastructure severely damaged. Soccer's governing body made the announcement on Thursday in Washington during the first meeting of President Donald Trump's Board of Peace. item.title: Cherished teacher mourned following deadly crash with driver who was being pursued by ICE
item.description: Kindergarten and first grade students at a Georgia school are mourning their teacher days after she was killed by a driver who authorities say was fleeing federal immigration officers. Principal Alonna McMullen says it was heartbreaking telling 5 and 6 year old students in Linda Davis' special needs classes of her death. item.title: Memorial services for Rev. Jesse Jackson expanded to include South Carolina and Washington, DC
item.description: Memorial services honoring the life of the late Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr. will be expanded beyond Chicago with events in Washington, D.C., and South Carolina. The late civil rights leader’s organization announced Thursday that newly added events outside Chicago will take place from March 1 to March 4. Jackson died Tuesday at age 84 after battling a rare neurological disorder that affected his ability to move and talk. item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ star and ALS awareness advocate, dies at 53
item.description: Eric Dane, the actor known for “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Euphoria,” has died at 53 due to ALS. His representatives say he died on Thursday afternoon. His family says he spent his final days with loved ones. Dane rose to fame as Dr. Mark Sloan on “Grey’s Anatomy” and later played Cal Jacobs on “Euphoria.” He also starred on “The Last Ship,” where production paused as he battled depression.
